scope: Serial even-parity seed of three, one to three distinct legal parents per new junction, and two or three genuinely new distinctions per join. The runtime observation is the anonymous bond-distance table with just the unordered three candidates marked.
all_size_separator_converse: The connected components of the nonadditivity links after deleting one distinction are exactly the connected components of the physical incidence after deletion.
pruning: Reject a marked separator or marks split by a separator. For other triples retain the connected bridge component and every incident boundary distinction. Restrict the scalar table to these identities. Original and local eligibility agree for every surviving triple.
all_size_state_inverse: A full allowed-state transport preserves the three-parent verdict for whole presentations and for surviving candidates in genuinely retained pieces, even if no boundary distinction is marked.
mixed_subclass: Within the class with at most one two-fresh join which, if present, uses at least two parents, the short distances recover every junction at any finite width.
necessary_state_difference: An opposing marked isometry requires the image of some generating parity equation on four, five or six coordinates to be absent from the other parity space.
necessary_twin_bound: If a loose bit at u of a legal triple and its shared neighbor bit uv can be transposed while fixing all others, v has arity at least four. If v has a loose bit, its ordinary degree is at least two plus the number of loose bits at u. At arity four both sites introduced exactly two outputs.
width_22_reduced_failure: In the same bridge-free arrangement {14,15,20} may join and {14,15,16} may not. A permutation preserves the three marked rows and all pairs at distance at most four. The full matrices distinguish the marks by five versus zero distance-five pairs across the two specified distance shells.
open_questions: Can any two distinct reachable parity relations with isometric full scalar tables have opposite triple verdicts under a marked isometry?
If a retained-only opposing pair is found, can its unpruned tables also be identified on the same marks?

validation.evidence: Scoped uniform mathematical proofs, separate same-task proof reasoning and adversarial audit, and reproducible exhaustive checks on the declared finite populations and explicit countermodels.
